messages:
Maria (docs): heads-up: planning big docs rename /api/* -> /runtime/*. I split into 3 PRs: moves (#4825), redirects (#4826), migration note (#4827). Need merge order + reviewers.

Kevin (eng): redirects first to avoid 404s, but anchors changed in sdk-snippets. Add alias anchors in moved files.

Samir (content): will add duplicate anchors for compatibility and note changed param names.

Alex (platform): recommended sequence: merge #4826 (redirects+aliases) -> wait prod build -> merge #4825 (moves) -> merge #4827 if needed. Netlify previews are isolated.

Lina (QA): I'll run link-check + anchor smoke after each merge. Add checklist to PRs.

Maria (docs): using 302 for canary redirects, flip to 301 after 2 weeks. Mark #4825 do-not-squash. I'll add reviewers and monitoring playbook for 404 spikes.

docs-ci-bot: preview URLs: #4826 -> https://deploy-preview-4826--docs.redwood-inference.com, #4825 -> https://deploy-preview-4825--docs.redwood-inference.com; #4826 build: SUCCESS (link-check passed).
